notes: RFC-0046 and RFC-0047 are ratified per the corpus but have no scaffolded ratification-record file. This is a scaffold-completeness gap, not an uncertainty about ratification status.
RFC-0072 ratification is conditional on RFC-0071, which is not ratified; treat RFC-0072 as provisionally effective.

RFC-0075 is NOT ratified. It is a Candidate in rfcs/. A divergent ratification record exists at docs/specifications/red-deep-technical-spec/RFC-0075-Ratification-Record.md (see CONFLICT-0075-004); it is not adopted by this registry.
The legacy substring heuristic (status contains 'Ratified') yielded 16 and missed RFC-0001 ('Approved for Ratification'), RFC-0046, and RFC-0047. This registry replaces that heuristic.
